WeSynced was built for the small, quiet moments in a relationship — the ones that don't need a text message, just a feeling shared.

Instead of chats, notifications, or noise, WeSynced gives you one simple gesture: tap an emoji, and your partner sees exactly how you feel, right on their home screen.

No read receipts. No "are you free to talk?". No pressure to reply. Just a gentle, always-on thread between two people who care about each other.

Every detail — from the pastel colors to the calm animations — was chosen to feel like a soft nudge, not another app fighting for your attention.

WeSynced isn't trying to replace how you talk to your partner. It's just trying to sit quietly in the background, holding a small piece of "I'm thinking of you" until you're ready to say more.

Thank you for being part of its very first version. 💌

Getting Started

1. Tap "Generate Random ID" to create your own pairing code, or type in one your partner already shared with you.
2. Tap "Connect" to start syncing.
3. Once connected, tap any emoji below to update your mood — your partner sees it instantly.

Staying Connected

Your mood stays visible to your partner even if you close the app. It only changes when you pick a new one, or tap "Disconnect."

The Widget

Add the WeSynced widget to your home screen to see your partner's mood at a glance, without ever opening the app.

Disconnecting

Tapping "Disconnect" lets your partner know you've intentionally stepped away — until then, your last mood stays exactly as you left it.

Reconnecting

Just enter the same pairing ID again anytime to pick up right where you left off.
